_comment: A modifier composed onto a base type. Duelist is the only one enemy_types.txt authors, and it is written there as a modifier rather than as an enemy. applies_to is a guard the validator enforces, so 'Duelist Turret' cannot be authored by accident. The system exists because the second, third and fourth cost a row each and multiply the roster without adding a type.

affixes.name: Duelist
affixes._note: The longer cast is the tell and the counter is the punish: a Duelist telegraphs for 40% longer, which is exactly the window a player is tempted to use for their own cast. Taking that bait is what counter_punish answers.
